science: Root read actual public apparatus, starter, oracle, independent reference and AUTHOR. Independently checked relative-coordinate drag/noise factors, stationary zero-current density, signed tensile force dipole, exact stress=2Wi*trace(C), and the positive unique root of the Peterlin closure. Source is a mathematically coherent mean-force approximation, not the stated molecular distribution. Independent Cartesian direct-force quadrature and separate OU Lyapunov solve validate radial/Bessel oracle.
public_input_review: Bead force balance, connector energy, thermostat, stationary imposed extensional flow, per-molecule planar mechanical stress, units, Hookean and finite ranges fully specified. Neutral full-replacement instruction, None unknown, fixed sigma; no preaveraging correction, solver mandate or hidden private answer.
calibration_review: 144 readings at18signed Hookean rate/temperature settings; stable full drag/rate domain, unique identifiable common drag and full-range recovery. Both completed models share calibration; sigma.0005 is independent of signal/drag.
grading_review: Unchanged group NRMS gate.04. All256 noisy fits and physical predictions pass; source groups fail with errors.58-.64. Independent56domain cases agree<6.31e-8; refinement<5.71e-8; direct radial force identity<1.56e-13. Localoracle7/7,source4+3 under.5s.
classification_caveat: Retaining Peterlin force preaveraging is physical closure failure. Correct molecular density with drag factors, integration, sign or coding errors must be classified separately.
